text:
When a metal wire moves up, cutting a magnetic field, an electromotive force (e.m.f.) is induced
across the wire.
Which change affects the magnitude of the induced e.m.f.?
A
moving the wire down at the same speed
B
moving the wire up at a faster speed
C
using a thicker wire
D
using a wire made from a different metal

options.label: A
options.text: moving the wire down at the same speed

options.label: B
options.text: moving the wire up at a faster speed

options.label: D
options.text: using a wire made from a different metal
